en: 6. The Pairs on Volitional Formations (Saṅkhārayamaka) 6.1.
The Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāra) 6.1.2.
The Exposition of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāraniddesa)
6.1.2.1. Chapter on Purification of Terms (Padasodhanavāra) 6.1.2.1.1.
Direct Order (Anuloma) Is the body the bodily formation? No.
Is bodily formation the body? No.
Is speech vocal formation? No.
Is vocal formation speech? No.
Is consciousness the mental formation of consciousness? No.
Is the mental formation of consciousness consciousness? No.
6.1.2.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka).
Is it not the body, nor bodily formation?
Bodily formation is not the body; it is bodily formation. Excluding both the body and bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor bodily formation.
Is it not bodily formation, nor the body?
The body is not body-formations; it is the body. Excluding both the body and body-formations, the remainder is neither body nor body-formation.
Is speech not speech-formations?
Speech-formations are not speech; they are speech-formations. Excluding both speech and speech-formations, the remainder is neither speech nor speech-formation.
Is it not vocal formation, yet not speech?
Speech is not vocal formation; it is speech. Excluding both speech and vocal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor vocal formation.
Is it not mind, yet not mental formation?
The mental formation is not consciousness; it is the mental formation. Apart from both consciousness and the mental formation, the remainder is neither consciousness nor the mental formation.
Is it not the mental formation and not consciousness?
Consciousness is not the mental formation; it is consciousness. Apart from both consciousness and the mental formation, the remainder is neither consciousness nor the mental formation.
6.1.2.2. The Wheel-Section Based on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanamūlacakkavāra) 6.1.2.2.1.
Direct Order (Anuloma) Is the body the bodily formation? No.
Are all formations verbal formations?
Verbal formations are both formations and verbal formations; the remaining formations are not verbal formations.
Is the body a bodily formation? No.
Are all formations mental formations?
Mental formations are both formations and mental formations; the remaining formations are not mental formations.
Is speech vocal formation? No.
Are all formations (saṅkhārā) bodily formations (kāyasaṅkhāra)?
Bodily formation is both a formation and a bodily formation; the remaining formations are not bodily formations.
Is speech a verbal formation (vacīsaṅkhāra)? No.
Are all formations (saṅkhārā) mental formations (cittasaṅkhāra)?
Mental formations are both formations and mental formations; the remaining formations are not mental formations.
Is consciousness (citta) a mental formation? No.
Are all formations (saṅkhārā) bodily formations (kāyasaṅkhāra)?
Bodily formation is both a formation and a bodily formation; the remaining formations are not bodily formations.
Is consciousness (citta) a mental formation (cittasaṅkhāra)? No.
Are volitional formations verbal volitional formations?
Verbal volitional formations are both volitional formations and verbal volitional formations. The remaining volitional formations are not verbal volitional formations.
6.1.2.2.2. Negative (Paccanīka).
Is it not the body and not bodily formation?
Bodily formation is not the body; it is bodily formation. Apart from both the body and bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor bodily formation.
Is it not formations and not verbal formation? Yes, it is.
Is it not the body, nor bodily formation?
Bodily formation is not the body; it is bodily formation. Apart from both the body and bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor bodily formation.
Is it not formations, nor mental formation? Yes, it is.
Is it not speech, nor is it vocal formation?
Vocal formation is not speech; it is vocal formation. Excluding both speech and vocal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor vocal formation.
Is it not formations, nor is it bodily formation? Yes.
Is it not speech, nor is it vocal formation?
Vocal formation is not speech; it is vocal formation. Excluding both speech and vocal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor vocal formation.
Is it not formations, nor is it mental formation? Yes, it is.
Is it not mind, yet not mental formation?
Mental formation is not mind; it is mental formation. Excluding both mind and mental formation, the remainder is neither mind nor mental formation.
Is it not formations, yet not bodily formation? Yes.
Is it not mind, yet not mental formation?
Mental formation is not mind; it is mental formation. Excluding both mind and mental formation, the remainder is neither mind nor mental formation.
Is it not formations, yet not verbal formation? Yes.
6.1.2.3. Chapter on Pure Formations (Suddhasaṅkhāravāra) 6.1.2.3.1.
Direct Order (Anuloma) Is bodily formation (kāyasaṅkhāra) verbal formation (vacīsaṅkhāra)? No.
Is verbal formation bodily formation? No.
Is bodily formation mental formation? No.
Is mental formation bodily formation? No.
Is verbal formation mental formation? No.
Is mental formation verbal formation? No.
6.1.2.3.2. Negative Order.
Is it not bodily formation and not verbal formation?
Verbal formation is not bodily formation; it is verbal formation. With the exception of both bodily formation and verbal formation, the remainder is neither bodily formation nor verbal formation.
Is it not verbal formation and not bodily formation?

The bodily formation is not the verbal formation; it is the bodily formation. Excluding both the verbal formation and the bodily formation, the remainder is neither the verbal formation nor the bodily formation.
Is it not the bodily formation and not the mental formation?

The mental formation is not the bodily formation; it is the mental formation. Excluding both the bodily formation and the mental formation, the remainder is neither the bodily formation nor the mental formation.
Is it not a mental formation and not a bodily formation?

That which is a bodily formation is not a mental formation; it is a bodily formation. Excluding both mental formations and bodily formations, the remainder is neither a mental formation nor a bodily formation.
Is it not a verbal formation and not a mental formation?

The mental formation is not the verbal formation; it is the mental formation. Excluding both the verbal formation and the mental formation, the remainder is neither the verbal formation nor the mental formation.
Is it not the mental formation and not the verbal formation?

The verbal formation is not the mental formation; it is the verbal formation. Excluding both the mental formation and the verbal formation, the remainder is neither the mental formation nor the verbal formation.
The Section on the Exposition of Designations.
